heroHeadline: Brent Hits Crisis-High Near $108 as Houthis Open Second Chokepoint at Bab el-Mandeb, Then Eases on Iran-Gulf Talk Prospect
heroSubtitle: The war's largest wave of shipping attacks and a Houthi seizure of Yemen's Mokha port pushed oil to its highest level of the crisis, before word of a possible Sep 14 Iran-Gulf states meeting in Oman -- the first since the war began -- pulled prices back
